# Code of conduct

Bibites Multiverse welcomes people who want to learn, build, document, or study artificial life.
The community must remain safe and useful for participants with different backgrounds and skills.

## Expected behavior

- Treat other people with respect.
- Critique ideas and evidence, not people.
- Accept correction and update inaccurate claims.
- Keep technical disagreements specific and reproducible.
- Respect privacy, consent, and the boundaries of participant systems.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, threats, discrimination, or personal attacks
- Sexualized language or unwanted sexual attention
- Publication of private information without permission
- Deliberate disruption of the project, hosted service, or participant worlds
- Repeated bad-faith arguments after a maintainer gives a clear decision

## Scope

This code applies in repository spaces and project communications. It also applies when a person
represents the project in another public space.

## Enforcement

Send a private conduct report to Jorge Pineda at `j_jorge_p@msn.com`. Do not open a public issue
for a sensitive report.

Include the relevant links, dates, and context. The maintainer will keep the report private as far
as possible and can request more information.

The maintainer can edit or remove content, close discussions, block users, or revoke project
access. The response will depend on the severity and pattern of the behavior.
